## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `162680edace8bac25e4827a8113451227f805d78`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md + packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-pressed.test.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts (SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES), packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx, ui/packages/core/src/utils/kanban-declared-lanes.ts, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, scripts/role-word-baseline.json, packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts, packages/skills/package.json, .changeset/28243-skills-ui-i18n-teach-six-keys.md

Inputs read: the six cards (#28243, #28464, #28190, #28215, #28212, #28207) with every comment, PR #28488's body, file list and net diff against its merge-base with `main` (82b29fe5; `origin/main` is 9b4d1933 at review time, and the only movement on the cited files since the merge-base is the ADR-0146 `OverrideDeclarationFields` spread on four schemas plus an unrelated hunk in `containers.tsx` — nothing this PR teaches moved), and the check-runs on the head. The cited code was read on `origin/main` 9b4d1933. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not inputs.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff publishes one thing: the `skills/**` tree inside `@objectstack/skills` (packages/skills/package.json, `files` carries `skills`). It changes no Zod schema, no lint rule, no renderer and no generated artifact; the accept set of every door (`os validate`, publish, parse) is untouched. What changes is what the catalog TEACHES about an accept set that already exists on `main`. Each teaching, judged against the code it cites:

1. `pressed` (actions.md bullet) — RIGHT. `ActionSchema.pressed` is `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` "over the same scope as `visible`" (action.zod.ts 1684, docblock 1657-1683); the boolean literal is refused (action-pressed.test.ts 59-65); `active` / `activeWhen` / `pressedWhen` rename onto it (action.zod.ts 1014); the per-reader block is `attachedOnRead`, filled by "a service, or an app's `afterFind` hook" and read with `has()` (object.zod.ts 2441-2470; the describe's own example is the sentence the skill copies); the drawing surface is the record header — `page:header` (`containers.tsx` 2454-2468, 2508-2523, `aria-pressed`) and the record view's `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` 219-233 — and no list surface reads it, so "the record header draws it" is exact. "Display only, never a gate" is the renderer's own comment.
2. The five `{{ }}` copy slots (actions.md bullet) — RIGHT. action-copy-template.ts 29-45: `confirmText`, `description` and a param's `helpText` read `record` (plus `params` only when `params` is an object of static values, which a registered action's input-list `params` never is, so the skill's "read `record`" is exact for `defineAction`); `successMessage` and each `outcomeMessages` entry read `result` and `record`; `errorMessage` binds nothing. The four refusals the skill names (`${…}`, single-brace `{x}`, logic in a hole, a blank sentence) are the doors' list at 56-70, and they apply "wherever it stands" — "in all of them" is right. The three examples mirror the module's own `EXAMPLE` table (143-145) with `owner` in place of `role` (see ③).
3. `confirmText` beside a non-empty `params` refused, "put the question on `description`" (actions.md bullet) — RIGHT for the registered action (action.zod.ts 2251-2262, the refusal's own remedy). One precision gap: the refinement reaches `ActionSchema` only — a view's `bulkActionDefs` pairs the two by its own contract (2240-2248) — and the same bullet list goes on to teach `bulkActionDefs`' `confirmText` two lines later without the qualifier. Should-fix (④ S1).
4. `submitText` (actions.md bullet, `ReassignLeadAction` example, eval 11, i18n `_actions` row) — RIGHT. An I18nLabel (`actionSubmitText`, 966-969), refused blank (`SUBMIT_TEXT_BLANK`), refused without a non-empty `params` (2272-2283), `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` renamed onto it (1011), the dialog's default "Confirm" (useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx 345-349), the bundle slot `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText` with `globalActions.ACTION.submitText` for an object-less action (translation.zod.ts 221-224, 514, 1043). The example adds `submitText: 'Reassign'` to an action that already carries a one-entry `params`, `type: 'api'` and no `confirmText`, so the block still parses under the two co-constraints; `check:skill-examples` is CI's.
5. The thank-you keys (i18n `_views` row) — RIGHT. `_views.{view}.submitBehavior.title` / `.message`, applied only where the form authors a `kind: 'thank-you'` panel; the three other kinds author no copy (translation.zod.ts 271-297, 336-337, 386-403). Not taught, and not asked by #28215: the same shape's second address under `pages.{page}.components.{id}.submitBehavior` for a page `object-form`. Noted, no finding.
6. `kanban.lanes` (list-views.md example and note) — RIGHT in substance. Ordered stored option values of `groupByField` (view.zod.ts 2357-2365); a choice of lanes, not a record filter, an unlisted value lands in `Uncategorized`, filter the view to keep records off the board, omit it for one lane per option in the options' own order (docblock 2321-2355; kanban-declared-lanes.ts 10-40); the two lint refusals (validate-list-view-field-refs.ts 1091-1112 unknown option, 1117-1141 repeated). One precision gap: the unknown-option refusal is judged only against the group field's INLINE `options` — a picklist-backed group field, or one with no inline options, is not judged (370-394). Should-fix (④ S2).
7. `seriesBy` (dashboards.md example and note) — RIGHT. A second dataset dimension splitting the one `yAxis` measure into a series per value (report.zod.ts 33-57; DatasetReportRenderer.tsx 1375-1395 queries `[xAxis, seriesBy]` × `[yAxis]`); an undeclared name refused at the lint door exactly like `xAxis` (validate-chart-bindings.ts 589-604); refused when it names `xAxis` and on the single-series types (report.zod.ts 147-203); the five types the skill spells are `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` verbatim (dashboard.zod.ts 811-817: pie, donut, funnel, treemap, sankey); with it set `series[].name` names a value of the dimension (describe at 53-57; the lint stops judging `series[].name` against measures at 605-611). The example's `close_date` is a declared dimension of the `opportunity_metrics` dataset the comment above the block already names, with quarter granularity, and is not the `xAxis`, so the example passes both arms. Wording gap: "not a `matrix` workaround" sits under a `type: 'matrix'` report — the contrast meant is the owner-by-stage pivot used in place of a split chart (card #28207's words), not the report type the example itself declares. Should-fix (④ S3).
8. Eval 11 — RIGHT. The prompt needs the new key (a dialog whose button reads the verb is `submitText` and nothing else on `main`); `must_contain` is `params` plus `submitText: 'Log Call'`; `must_not_contain` is exactly the three spellings the spec refuses beside `params` (`confirmText` at 2251, `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` at 1011), so a correct answer cannot be refused by the negative set. The single-quoted literal in `must_contain` is the fixture's standing convention (cases 1, 3, 9, 10 pin the same shape) in a single-quoted codebase.
9. The eval fixture is measured, not ratcheted; the four ratcheted files, priced from the blobs at the head by the gate's own convention `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` (stamp line excluded on the SKILL.md), read 2255/2259, 3108/3129, 6260/6262 and 5646/6333 against the `CEILINGS` rows at scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs 825, 857, 846, 511 — no ceiling row moves, which is what the file list shows (the script is not in the diff). Reading, tree `refs/review/pr-28488` 162680ed. The `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` generators read SKILL.md FRONTMATTER and the zod mapping respectively (build-skill-docs.ts header; build-skill-references.ts header), so an i18n body edit owes no regenerated artifact and none is missing. `scripts/role-word-baseline.json` holds no row for actions.md and the `role` count is 0 before and after on every edited file.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28243-skills-ui-i18n-teach-six-keys.md` bumps `@objectstack/skills` alone at `patch`, and that is the one package the diff moves (the tree it ships is `skills/**`). The body and the PR body each carry the two line-initial declarations, the clause-② line reading `no` with no arm and the metadata-protocol line reading `none`: no key, value or metadata type is added, narrowed or re-meant — the keys taught all exist on `main` with the semantics the skill now states — so `none` takes `patch` by the Post-Task Checklist rule. No BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 disposition and no migration is owed; none is written. The declared face is the rules face (`skills/**`, a governed register row), which is why this record exists at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; `Check Changeset` on the head concluded `success`. RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

The os-dev-report (comment 6550711618 on #28243) carries `open_questions: []` and two `out_of_scope_findings`, both "none filed"; its other fields raise one process point. Each, answered:

- `role` → `owner` in the `description` example: the spec's reference sentence (action-copy-template.ts 143) carries the word `check:role-word` ratchets in published prose; the skill's example says `owner`, the hole and the root are unchanged, and the ratchet baseline needs no row (actions.md counts 0 → 0). ANSWERED — the swap is the right remedy, not a drift.
- No i18n eval added: no derived gate requires one, the two new i18n facts are table rows, and `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` is untouched. ANSWERED — acceptable; an eval asking for a thank-you translation would be welcome but is not owed by this fold.
- `premise_still_valid: true`: re-checked on the head tree — under `skills/`, the only mentions of `submitText` / `submitBehavior` outside the five edited files are the generated `references/react-blocks.md` rows for the `object-form` block, and `pressed`, `seriesBy` and `kanban.lanes` appear nowhere else. CONFIRMED.
- `mcp_calls` notes the harness's assignee/reviewer step was skipped because the frame forbids MCP writes, and the PR indeed carries no assignee while the discipline says the PR's assignee mirrors the card's at `pr_create`. ESCALATED to the owning seat as a relay write to make before landing; it is not a property of the tree and does not bear on the verdict.
- Every member's `Blocked-by:` target is closed (#28242 / PR #28301, PR #28463, PR #28188 + #28158, PR #28195, #28211 / PR #28291, #28206 / PR #28305 with the refusal arms of PR #28439), confirmed on the cards' own unblock comments and by the cited code being on `main`, so no member teaches a key that draws nothing. No member dropped.

Gate verdicts on the head at review time: 24 check-runs `success` (among them `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build Core`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test UI`, `Live E2E UI`, the `Lint ·` family — ESLint, CI/release/engine gates, docs and code guards, repo and tooling gates, PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lints — and `Type Check · workspace`, `· source gates`, `· debt ledger`, `Test Core (2/8)`), 13 `skipped` by path filter (the `ui/` lane: `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `UI Published Artifacts`, plus opt-in harnesses), 0 failures, and 2 still `in_progress`: `Test Core (1/8)` and `Type Check · consumer gates`. Those two are not yet a pass; the landing waits for them regardless of this record's verdict.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged on the tree, file by file, against the code named in ① and the cards' prompts.

**actions.md (−58 / +33).** Every deleted line was traced to its home:

- The "Predicates are bare CEL" paragraph folds into the `visible` bullet: bare CEL, the `record.`-prefixed field form resolves identically on every surface, never `${…}` or `{…}` wrapped, see `objectstack-formula`. The phrase "prefer it over the bare-field form" is dropped while its reason sentence is kept; the preference still reads from it. Kept.
- The `ctx` section: the blessed-name code block becomes the same expression inline (`ctx.user?.organizationId ?? ctx.session?.organizationId`); the "two isolation axes / same `undefined` cases as hooks" text was already a pointer, and data-hooks.md 362-363 and 588-608 carry the table and the comment that the value equals `organization_id` / `current_user.organizationId`; the trusted-execution rule, the `ctx.session.positions` absent-when-none fact and the ADR-0095 "not an authorization input" rule all survive in the one paragraph. Kept.
- The "two mechanisms" lead-in: the two subsections remain and the `params` warning still says "one of the two mechanisms above". Kept.
- `openIn` / `opensInNewTab` / `newTabUrl` prose: static vs computed URL, `'self'`, the omitted-key default (action.zod.ts 1202), synchronous pre-open, `redirectUrl`, the `/`-rooted path with `{recordId}`, external URL refused, valid only with `opensInNewTab: true` (1838-1844, 2363-2376), own-auth endpoint — every rule is in the condensed text. Kept.
- The `params` warning drops "an object form `params: { newTab: true }` fails the zod build outright" and keeps the array-form trap and the rule itself (`ActionParam[]`, user input only). The object reading is retired on the spec side (1426) and refused with its own prescription, so the dropped sentence had the schema as its home. Kept in substance.
- "Always" / "Best practice" lead-ins trimmed; `refreshAfter: true` stays as the closing rule. Kept.
- No hunk is a re-wrap for budget: each changed paragraph is rewritten, and the byte deltas come from the rewrites. Cosmetic only: the rewritten `ctx` paragraph opens with a ~125-character line and wraps the rest at 80.

New sentences and examples: judged in ① items 1-4; all key names, value shapes, defaults, scopes and refusal spellings match `main`.

**list-views.md (−10 / +8).** The three deleted bullets (`toggle` deprecated per ADR-0047; the switcher is a compact dropdown and a single-entry whitelist locks it; `groupByField` is a select, one column per option) become the code comments beside `element`, `allowedVisualizations` and `groupByField` — the rule each carried survives at the spot an author copies. Lost with them: the "§3.4a" citation and "stays in the enum for back-compat rendering", neither an authoring rule; the later Rules bullet still says the full `dropdown | tabs | toggle` range is page-only, as before. The `lanes` example lists three option values of `status` in an order the options' own order does not dictate, which is exactly the key's reason for existing. Judged in ① item 6.

**dashboards.md (−8 / +7).** The "Engine support" bullet (per-driver bucket functions) describes the engine, not what an author writes, and keeps a home at skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md 82; the "Studio's Dashboard Widget Inspector" bullet describes Studio and tells an author nothing to write. The bucket-label table and "Human labels are automatic" keep the author-facing fact. Judged in ① item 7.

**views-apps-actions-pages.json (+10).** Judged in ① item 8; valid JSON, the same shape as cases 1-10.

**objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md (−2 / +2).** Judged in ① items 4 and 5; 687 tokens of headroom, no deletion needed.

Findings:

- S1 (should-fix) — actions.md, `confirmText` bullet: say the refusal beside `params` is the registered action's; a `bulkActionDefs` entry pairs them by its own contract, and the bullet list teaches that entry's `confirmText` two lines later.
- S2 (should-fix) — list-views.md, `lanes` note: "a value that is not an option" is judged against the group field's inline `options` only; a picklist-backed group field is not judged. "not one of the field's inline options" would be exact.
- S3 (should-fix) — dashboards.md, `seriesBy` note: "not a `matrix` workaround" under a `type: 'matrix'` example reads as if the report type were wrong; name the pivot it replaces (a second dimension in `columns` standing in for a split chart).
- S4 (should-fix, cosmetic) — actions.md `ctx` paragraph line width.

Must-fix: none. Nothing the PR teaches contradicts `main`; the three precision gaps above narrow or widen a true rule by one unstated exception or one ambiguous word, and none would lead an author to write metadata that `os validate` refuses or that draws nothing.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-0tmmio`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzCtJt8Q2Z63fyRNix`

**VERDICT: PASS**
